Weather-adjusted commercial KWH sales increased 6.4% primarily due to additional sales from data centers.

Southern Power committed to development projects to upgrade certain turbines at its existing Franklin and Wansley natural gas facilities, which are projected to add up to 400 MWs of incremental capacity.
Southern Power placed in service 51 MWs of the 200-MW repowering project at the Kay wind facility.

Southern Power's average investment coverage ratio for its generating assets, including those owned with various partners, based on the ratio of investment under contract to total investment was 97% through 2030 and 88% through 2035.
Changes in rates resulted in an increase in revenues in the first quarter 2026 compared to the corresponding period in 2025 primarily due to base rate increases at Nicor Gas and Atlanta Gas Light.
